div.span: Phase 1: In-Memory Parsing & Multi-Point Staging Validation
Process Each Valid Item in Batch

Create Authoritative SemesterResult Document:
studentId, courseId, marks, grade, status (PASS/FAIL)

Is Passing Grade?
(O, A+, A, B+, B, C, P)

Credits Earned = 0
(Result recorded, no credit awarded)

Execute Deterministic SHA-256 Engine:
generateCreditHash(studentId, courseId, instId, credits, grade, sem, year)

Create AcademicCredit Record:
verificationStatus = 'verified', integrityHash = sha256
Link creditId back into SemesterResult document
Did student pass ALL registered semester courses?
Multer In-Memory Buffer (Zero Disk Residue / High Security)

Upload .xlsx File with Semester & Academic Year
(POST /api/institution/results/preview)
Pre-load Institutional Catalog & Enrolled Students into Memory Maps
Student ABC ID Exists & Enrolled in Institution?
Flag Row: Invalid Student ABC ID
Flag Row: Course Code Not in Catalog
Duplicate Student + Course in Uploaded File?
Flag Warning: Duplicate Record in Sheet
Flag Warning: Student already awarded credit for course
Mark Row as Valid for Import
Aggregate Statistics: Total, Valid, Ineligible & Duplicate Counts
Create ResultImportBatch Document (Status: PREVIEW) in MongoDB
Academic Officer Enters Results Import Hub
Populate Spreadsheet with Student ABC IDs, Course Codes, Marks & Grades
Frontend Renders Interactive Validation Preview Modal
Results Imported & Credits Awarded Successfully (200 OK)
